note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings about a company's metrics, data model, dashboards and questions answered with its own data, and near-miss negatives a neighbouring skill owns. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: how should we calculate churn for our subscription business
why did signups drop last month
what KPIs should our company dashboard track
can we trust the conversion rate in this report
do customers who came from referrals retain better than paid ones
our activation number is different in two reports, which one is right
set up a tested data model for our orders and customers tables
is the lift from our pricing page test real or just noise
pull our monthly active users for the last six months, with how it is defined

near_miss.query: turn this table of monthly signups into a line chart
what is the average churn rate for SaaS companies
how big is the market for pet insurance in Europe
build the three-statement financial model for our startup
forecast next quarter's revenue from our sales pipeline
should we raise our prices next quarter
